purpose: Pilot local event relevance disambiguation. Small mixed live/benchmark/synthetic gold set; NOT a statistically powered validation set.
annotation_policy: Label means event itself adds/supports/fixes specified technology in requested domain; mentioning it in docs is not enough.
For LoRA-LLM, require LLM/transformer/PEFT/fine-tuning context; LoRa radio and image-only diffusion negatives.
For RAG, require retrieval augmented language-model or document-answering context; red-amber-green negatives.
The live items reproduce 2026-10-08 pilot text; benchmark/synthetic entries are not fresh independently fetched evidence.
